title: 第2270章 这个怪圈挺讨厌的第2269章 这开幕式应该截然不同了吧
lines: 路天行狼狈苦笑中正打算扭转心态，一道身影就突兀出现在了他面前，这又吓了路天行一跳，来者则洒然笑道，“道友，可想回你转世之前的仙界？”
一句话，路仙帝惊的目瞪口呆。
转世夺尸重生这回事，他可从没有告诉过任何人的。
更觉得这世界不应该有人能看穿这一点才对。
瞠目一息，路天行才凝重道，“不知阁下？”
来者淡然道，“我是苏恒，若我预估的不差，目前实力境界应该和道友陨落前的仙帝境相仿。两年多前就发现了道友的古怪气息，只不过当时想要以道友那一丝残魂去定位你出身的仙界，会对你伤害太大，你的灵魂强度根本不足以支撑跨界之旅。”
“现在，只要道友突破到元婴境，灵魂强度就足够定位仙界了，我或许也可以打开一条通道，一起去看看。”
两年多时间，苏恒不是白过的，游历过一个个位面的风景，看过一些主角的崛起之路后，他就随意找了个地方，利用流光境这天地灵宝去加速修炼，一比三千的时间流速，加上手中有着充沛的资源。
目前苏恒吞星决30级，已经到了开创世界的程度，也演化出了新的小千世界。
天解经30级、天公圣言术30级，他此刻加上葬神界的话，已经足足掌握了四个小千世界，无非是后面三个小千世界，苏恒并没有去创造生灵。
但不管怎么说，他都是掌控四个小世界的造物主创世主了。
神王境里，也是相当能打的存在了。
对目前苏恒来说，他最看重的还是齐宣所联通的，能够完成任务随意获取人物目标奖励的愿力世界，以及路天行所能连通的仙界。
进入仙界，研究一下那里的仙灵之气到底是怎么回事，若能大量引入他成长的银河系，就有概率大批量造就出长生群体啊。
两年多时间，他还没有回去过，但想来以人族的实力和资源底蕴，借助各式各样的修炼宝地去加速提升，目前的人族肯定战力爆表。
就算苏恒没回去，但天解经没发出过任何不好的预警，外加他父亲和崇祯等都是神明级强者坐镇，那里人族是不惧一般麻烦的。
随着苏恒解释，路天行情绪剧烈波动几下，才笑道，“没想到这里还有阁下这般强者……不过我毕竟是借尸重生，这具身躯和我的灵魂还没有完美契合，元婴之前不是大事，元婴之后若不彻底弥补了这先天缺陷，以后的路会越走越艰难。”
苏恒哑然，“你需要什么尽管开口。”
路天行说出几件宝物，就见苏恒言出法随，硬生生凭空创造出了他所需的宝物……
路天行深深看了苏恒一眼，恭敬行了一礼，才抓起各种宝药就吞服下去，当着苏恒的面去炼化这些药力。
几个小时一晃而过，路天行再次起身时，已经多了许多从容。
“我已经元婴了，区区幼儿级元神就不在阁下面前献丑了，现在阁下可以用我的灵魂去定位仙界了。”
苏恒也不客气，道法一展，纯粹的创世之力激荡在路天行灵魂层面，几个呼吸后就在附近撕开一个世界壁垒，卷着曾经的天帝消失不见。
诸天万界，一方浩大的仙域勾连着诸多小千世界，小千世界绝大部分生灵，终其一生都难以在逆天之路的小关卡、合道境之后飞升仙域。
但生于仙域的生灵却截然不同，仙域的生灵几乎是出生起就浸泡在充满了长生物质的仙气环境里。
在仙域的生灵，哪怕是再愚钝而不可铸造的智慧族群，在修炼一道上根本走不下去，也能被仙气滋养的活上千载以上，而修仙者行列，寿元更是漫长到夸张的地步。
合道之上，天仙就是长生不老，天仙之上有真仙、金仙、大罗、仙王。
当然，这个仙域里不管是大罗还是仙王，都只是长生并不是不灭，否则路天行也不会被围攻的转世，只剩下一丝残魂再借助一个死去的青年肉身重生了。
寿元，对于仙域的许多存在来说，都是漫长的可以忽略的，根本不值得太执着的去追求，这个仙域，最令大罗或者仙王们疯狂的，只有一件事，身合世界，晋为仙域天道级存在，那就是真正不死不灭，到时候更是仙域以及其下属各小千世界，真正的主宰。
“两年多前，我就是和其他几方仙王，意外发现了一座古王遗址，在里面找到了有机会身合仙域的契机，从而爆发了生死之战，真没想到会有后续的各种经历。”
“最初，我还以为转世的地球，只是仙域麾下某一方小千世界，还是那种灵力禁绝，超凡之路断绝的死寂世界，现在看来是大错特错。”
重新踏足仙界，呼吸着记忆中熟悉无比的充满仙气、充满长生物质的气体，路天行都激动的有些泪目。
更是用灵魂碰触的方式，快速给苏恒解释仙域的大概，这一方仙域，几乎无边无尽还联通不少小千世界，绝大部分时期仙域都是平和的，大范围无大争的，被八方仙王统治。
只有以身合仙域的契机出现后，才会引发各种仙王之战，包括众仙王的附属势力之战，而仙域那一个个陨落的仙王、大罗、金仙等等，都是差不多的情况死掉的。
仙王以上只有一个主宰了，大家还都是长生不死，可以说在真正的主宰出现前，只要机会出现了，你不想争也得争，这里又不是一个仙王，往往一代都是七八个或更多。
你不争，其他仙王以身合仙域了，轻松操控你生死……
整个仙域长久以来，早就陷入了一个怪圈。
一代代几乎都能长生的仙人们，都是或被动或主动陷入主宰战里陨落，旧仙逝去，更有一代代新的大罗、仙王出现，重新统治一切。
你说资源消耗方面？每一个汲取天地仙力而壮大的仙人们，在死亡陨落后一切又归于天地，只是一个循环罢了。
路天行成为一方仙王也有十几万年了，他早就清楚一切，更觉得这个怪圈其实挺讨厌的，架不住真等机会出现了，你不争也要阻止其他仙王，免得以后被对方掌控一切。
content_en:
Lu Tianxing smiled wryly and was about to change his mentality when a figure suddenly appeared in front of him, which startled Lu Tianxing again. The visitor smiled casually and said, "Fellow Taoist, do you want to go back to the fairyland before your reincarnation?"
In one sentence, Lu Xiandi was stunned.
He had never told anyone about reincarnation and rebirth.
I also feel that no one in this world should be able to see through this.
After a breath of surprise, Lu Tianxing said solemnly, "I don't know, Your Excellency?"
The visitor said calmly, "I am Su Heng. If my estimate is correct, the current level of strength should be similar to the Immortal Emperor Realm before the death of fellow Taoist. I discovered the strange aura of fellow daoist more than two years ago, but at that time, I wanted to use the remnant soul of fellow daoist to locate the fairy world where you were born. It would be too harmful to you, and your soul strength is not strong enough to support the cross-realm journey."
"Now, as long as fellow Taoist breaks through to the Nascent Soul Realm, the soul strength will be enough to locate the fairy world. Maybe I can also open a passage and go and see together."
Su Heng spent more than two years in vain. After traveling through the scenery of various planes and seeing the rise of some protagonists, he randomly found a place and used the flowing light realm, a spiritual treasure of heaven and earth, to speed up his cultivation. The time flow rate was one to three thousand, plus he had abundant resources in his hands.
At present, Su Heng is at level 30 of Swallowing Stars, which has reached the level of creating a world, and has also evolved into a new Small Thousand Worlds.
At level 30 of Tian Jie Jing and level 30 of God's Holy Word, if he added the God Burial Realm at this moment, he had already mastered four small thousand worlds, just the next three small thousand worlds. Su Heng did not create living beings.
But no matter what, he is the creator and master who controls the four small worlds.
In the God King Realm, he is also quite capable of fighting.
For Su Heng, what he values ​​most is the world of wish that Qi Xuan connects to, where he can complete tasks and obtain character target rewards at will, and the fairy world that Lu Tianxing can connect to.
Enter the fairy world and study what the fairy spirit there is like. If a large amount of it can be introduced into the galaxy where he grew up, there is a chance that a large number of immortal groups will be created.
He has not been back for more than two years, but he thinks that with the strength and resource base of the human race, and the help of various cultivation treasures to accelerate improvement, the current human race will definitely have explosive combat power.
Even if Su Heng didn't go back, Tian Jie Jing didn't issue any bad warnings. In addition, his father and Chong Zhen were all god-level powerhouses, so the human race there was not afraid of ordinary troubles.
As Su Heng explained, Lu Tianxing's mood fluctuated violently for a few times before he smiled and said, "I didn't expect there to be someone as strong as you here... But after all, I was reborn from a corpse. This body and my soul have not yet perfectly matched. It was not a big deal before Yuanying. If this congenital defect is not completely made up for after Yuanying, the road ahead will become more and more difficult."
Su Heng was speechless, "If you need anything, just ask."
Lu Tianxing named a few treasures, and saw that Su Heng followed his instructions and created the treasures he needed out of thin air...
Lu Tianxing took a deep look at Su Heng, bowed respectfully, then grabbed various precious medicines and swallowed them, refining the power of these medicines in front of Su Heng.
A few hours passed by, and when Lu Tianxing stood up again, he was much more calm.
"I have become a Nascent Soul, and my mere infant-level soul will no longer show my shame in front of you. Now you can use my soul to locate the fairy world."
Su Heng was not polite. With a display of Taoism, the pure power of creation stirred up the soul level of Lu Tianxing. After a few breaths, a world barrier was torn open nearby, and the former Emperor of Heaven disappeared.
……………………
In all the heavens and worlds, a vast fairyland connects many small worlds. Most of the creatures in the small worlds will find it difficult to ascend to the fairyland after passing through the small pass on the road to defy heaven and the Hedao realm.
But the creatures born in the fairyland are completely different. The creatures in the fairyland are immersed in the fairy environment full of immortal substances almost from birth.
The creatures in the Immortal Realm, even if they are the stupid and unforgeable wisdom group who cannot continue on the path of cultivation, can still be nourished by the immortal energy and live for more than a thousand years, and the longevity of the ranks of immortal cultivators is even longer to the point of exaggeration.
Above the Hedao, the Immortal is immortal, and above the Immortal there are the True Immortal, the Golden Immortal, Da Luo, and the Immortal King.
Of course, both Da Luo and the Immortal King in this immortal realm are immortal but not immortal. Otherwise, Lu Tianxing would not be reincarnated under siege, and only a trace of his soul would be left to be reborn with the help of the body of a dead young man.
For many beings in the Immortal Realm, longevity is a long time that can be ignored, and it is not worth pursuing too persistently. In this Immortal Realm, what makes Da Luo or the Immortal Kings crazy the most is only one thing. If you fit into the world and be promoted to the Heavenly Dao level existence of the Immortal Realm, that is to be truly immortal. At that time, you will be the real master of the Immortal Realm and its subordinate worlds.
"More than two years ago, I and several other Immortal Kings accidentally discovered an ancient king's ruins, and found an opportunity to join the Immortal Realm. A battle of life and death broke out. I never expected that there would be various subsequent experiences."
"Initially, I thought that the reincarnated earth was just a small world under the Immortal Domain, or a dead world where spiritual power was forbidden and the road to transcendence was cut off. Now it seems that I was completely wrong."
Lu Tianxing was so excited that he burst into tears as he set foot in the fairy world again and breathed in the familiar gas full of fairy energy and immortality in his memory.
He also used the method of soul touching to quickly explain to Su Heng the general outline of the Immortal Realm. This Immortal Realm is almost endless and connected to many small worlds. For most of the time, the Immortal Realm was peaceful, without major disputes, and was ruled by Immortal Kings from all directions.
Only when an opportunity arises to join the Immortal Realm, will various wars among the Immortal Kings be triggered, including battles between the affiliated forces of the Immortal Kings. The fallen Immortal Kings, Daluo, Jinxian, etc. in the Immortal Realm all died in similar circumstances.
There is only one master above the Immortal King, and everyone is still immortal. It can be said that before the real master appears, as long as the opportunity arises, you have to fight if you don't want to. There is not one Immortal King here, there are usually seven or eight or more in one generation.
If you don't fight, the other Immortal Kings will fit into the Immortal Realm and easily control your life and death...
The entire Immortal Realm has been trapped in a strange circle for a long time.
Generations of immortals who were almost able to live forever, either passively or actively fell into the domination war and perished. The old immortals passed away, and new generations of Da Luo and Immortal Kings appeared to rule everything again.
Are you talking about resource consumption? Every immortal who absorbs the immortal power of heaven and earth and becomes stronger, after death and fall, everything returns to heaven and earth. It is just a cycle.
Lu Tianxing has been an Immortal King for hundreds of thousands of years. He has known everything for a long time, and he feels that this strange circle is actually quite annoying. If the opportunity arises, you must stop other Immortal Kings without fighting, so as not to be controlled by the other party in the future.
title_en: Chapter 2270 This strange circle is quite annoying. Chapter 2269 This opening ceremony should be completely different.
